# Maison Sirivan

> Concept store in Kandal Village, Siem Reap, Cambodia, for clothes and home pieces designed by Sirivan Chak-Dumas and made in her own workshop, Sirivan Atelier de Couture, in small batches and in every size. Also at Atelier 464, Phnom Penh.

Adresse : 477 & 478 Hup Guan Street, Kandal Village, Siem Reap, Cambodia
